decision: CSharp emits the _fltused definition in every native Windows prefix. Native omitted it, exposing a DLL float operation dependency when the same nodefaultlib linker is used. Emit the same compiled NativeRuntimePolicy constant for 64-bit Windows only; keep Linux and wasm boundaries unchanged.
next: Execute the generated policy against real compiled CSharp results in both compilers, run current semantic/stdlib preflights, then consume the remaining unchanged cumulative whole-build time budget.
